obligations.label: bucket token in range
obligations.claim: 0 <= token < bucket_tokens for every launched warp

obligations.label: route index in range
obligations.claim: 0 <= routed < top_k for every launched warp

obligations.label: sampled neuron in range
obligations.claim: 0 <= neuron < sampled_intermediate for every launched warp

obligations.label: packed hidden scale mapping in range
obligations.claim: 0 <= min((packed_col * 2) / 16, scale_columns - 1) < scale_columns when 0 <= packed_col < packed_hidden_size

obligations.label: no expert-major padding
obligations.claim: launched work count is bucket_tokens * top_k * sampled_intermediate, independent of unique expert count
